title: Windows x64 select integer or floating point register by argument position
summary: The first four arguments to a prototyped function use positional register slots, with separate integer and floating-point registers for each slot.
applies: 64-bit native ABI; interprets types and calls based on build target
detail: For example, the three parameters of void f(int,double,int) are usually in ECX, XMM1, R8D. The second parameter occupies position 2 and is therefore not XMM0.
boundary: There are additional rules for large aggregates, no prototypes, and variadic arguments; Linux's System V ABI uses different classifications.
relevance: Correspond one-to-one values with source-level parameters in the snapshot of the normal function entry.
